07_band_distribution.png: Risk-band counts and fraud density on the full file. Fraud-labelled records are a subset of all records; empty bands are explicitly noted. Class is used only for evaluation after scoring.
08_fraud_capture.png: Full-file fraud capture versus queue capacity. The minimum K reaching 50% capture is 2,068; K=52 captures no frauds. The curve is a step function; Class is never a ranking key.
01_time_vs_n_C2.png: Sorting cost grows very differently on shuffled input. C2 uses a seeded shuffle. Timing points are medians of five completed runs; missing points are DNF and are never interpolated. Counts use the documented comparison/move convention.

04_moves_vs_n_C2.png: Record movement separates the sorting strategies. C2 uses a seeded shuffle. Timing points are medians of five completed runs; missing points are DNF and are never interpolated. Counts use the documented comparison/move convention.
05_time_nlogn_vs_n_C2.png: Normalising by n log n tests the expected growth. C2 uses a seeded shuffle. Timing points are medians of five completed runs; missing points are DNF and are never interpolated. Counts use the documented comparison/move convention.
06_time_n2_vs_n_C2.png: Quadratic normalisation exposes insertion sort. C2 uses a seeded shuffle. Timing points are medians of five completed runs; missing points are DNF and are never interpolated. Counts use the documented comparison/move convention.
02_time_by_condition_n10000.png: Five-run median execution time by input condition at n=10,000. Grouped bars use a log time axis and identify the actual contenders.
report_C_tournament.png: Tournament: C2 growth in time, comparisons and moves; condition comparison at n=10,000; time normalised by n log₂ n and n². The shared legend applies to every panel. DNF points are absent.
09_topk_cost.png: Cost of producing an ordered Top-K queue, including final publication. Five-run medians at both required sizes and C1/C2; the dotted guide marks K=52. Full sort is measured separately at each K, including its prefix copy; DNF is not plotted as zero.
report_D_topk.png: Cost of producing an ordered Top-K queue, including final publication. Five-run medians at both required sizes and C1/C2; the dotted guide marks K=52. Full sort is measured separately at each K, including its prefix copy; DNF is not plotted as zero.

11_livefeed_10min.png: Median cumulative time at each publication over five complete 10-minute-window simulations. Log time reveals all strategies. Any explicit DNF has an annotation and no fabricated trajectory.
